one_line: The paper develops and analyzes (on data from 11 Russian mining enterprises) an automated, ISO 50001 / Industry 4.0 energy-efficiency management system for mining operations (excavators, dump trucks, locomotives), with any continuous-flow/Corpus-B sectors appearing only in the reference list.
